verdict.rationale: Base44 documentation describes custom domains (docs-8, docs-26, docs-32) and 'eject'/clone commands (docs-1, docs-22) that create a new Base44-hosted project with its own app ID, not deployment to external hosting or self-managed infrastructure — the app remains served by Base44 itself. There is no documented export/self-host workflow, Docker image, or instructions to run the generated backend on a developer's own servers or third-party cloud.
